Rules: Emperor Edition core rules; curated Effect/Ability IDs, never inferred from prose.

Cards.Name: Mirumoto Rokai
Cards.Text: Reaction: After another player's action targets your Personality at Rokai's location, destroy Rokai: Negate your Personality's destruction from the action's effects.

Cards.Name: Tamori Tamoko
Cards.Text:
Open: If it is not your turn, target an unbowed Personality controlled by the active player: Before the turn ends, gain 1 Honor if he was not assigned to attack your provinces this turn.
Reaction: Before an action resolves, target a Personality: Negate either his movement or straightening from the action's effects.

Cards.Name: Mirumoto Hikaro
Cards.Text:
After Hikaro enters play: Discard all your other Sensei Personalities.
Before you focus in a duel involving your Dragon Clan Personality: Once per duel, you may focus from your discard pile instead. Remove that card from the game after the duel ends.

Cards.Name: Mirumoto Yozo
Cards.Text:
After Yozo enters play or overlays: Discard all your other Sensei Personalities.
After your Iaijutsu action resolves: Give any Personality who performed it +2F.
